raw: Gradually, more and more people lose control of their emotions. Their cries join together and echo through the halls, for the poor mother and her stillborn child.
content: Gradually, more and more people lose control of their emotions. Their cries join together and echo through the halls, for the poor mother and her stillborn child.
Then, another cry rings out.

raw: It is not a sad sound. It is young and bright.
content: It is not a sad sound. It is young and bright.

raw: The fledgling arborbeast opens its eyes, and, as though sensing the emotions of the crowd, cries out for the first time in its life. It stretches its limbs, and the sheen miraculously returns to its fur.
content: The fledgling arborbeast opens its eyes, and, as though sensing the emotions of the crowd, cries out for the first time in its life. It stretches its limbs, and the sheen miraculously returns to its fur.

raw: The Matriarch embraces the newborn life tightly, crying tears of joy. One such tear drops from the empty eye sockets behind her veil, falling upon the fledgling's head, reflecting the light of the sun.
content: The Matriarch embraces the newborn life tightly, crying tears of joy. One such tear drops from the empty eye sockets behind her veil, falling upon the fledgling's head, reflecting the light of the sun.

raw: The fledgling does not stop crying. As though driven by the wailing, the light begins to break free of the void's shackles, becoming rich and full—
content: The fledgling does not stop crying. As though driven by the wailing, the light begins to break free of the void's shackles, becoming rich and full—
A halo.

raw: The mark of the Sankta, the symbol of the Law, the embodiment of truth. It has illuminated this unfamiliar creature—
content: The mark of the Sankta, the symbol of the Law, the embodiment of truth. It has illuminated this unfamiliar creature—
A shining, miraculous beacon.

raw: [name="Matriarch"]The Lord has once again answered our prayer. He has blessed this child.
speaker: Matriarch
content: The Lord has once again answered our prayer. He has blessed this child.

raw: [name="Matriarch"]This is a miracle not seen in a thousand years. Its appearance on the eve of calamity is a revelation from the Law.
speaker: Matriarch
content: This is a miracle not seen in a thousand years. Its appearance on the eve of calamity is a revelation from the Law.

raw: [name="Matriarch"]We are all witnesses. We are all participants.
speaker: Matriarch
content: We are all witnesses. We are all participants.

raw: [name="Matriarch"]Henceforth, we are born equal and one, beginning with the Holy City, and ending with the Holy City.
speaker: Matriarch
content: Henceforth, we are born equal and one, beginning with the Holy City, and ending with the Holy City.

speaker: Matriarch
content: —As Sankta.

raw: In the Matriarch's embrace, the newborn licks her arms. He has awakened.
content: In the Matriarch's embrace, the newborn licks her arms. He has awakened.

raw: Once again, the comfort bells sway. A new heartbeat, strong and regular, fills the Shrine of Nurtury.
content: Once again, the comfort bells sway. A new heartbeat, strong and regular, fills the Shrine of Nurtury.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Laterano granted a halo to an arborbeast fledgling?
speaker: Arturia
content: Laterano granted a halo to an arborbeast fledgling?

raw: [name="Arturia"]Even the most incredible miracle in The Saints' Travels pales in comparison.
speaker: Arturia
content: Even the most incredible miracle in The Saints' Travels pales in comparison.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Is this a divine blessing, or a terrible calamity?
speaker: Arturia
content: Is this a divine blessing, or a terrible calamity?

raw: [name="Federico"]My greater concern is whether it is true, whether it should be believed.
speaker: Federico
content: My greater concern is whether it is true, whether it should be believed.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Since when did you start doubting everything you see?
speaker: Arturia
content: Since when did you start doubting everything you see?

speaker: Federico
content: There are too many details, Arturia.

speaker: Federico
content: The unusual confessional.

speaker: Arturia
content: The boundless wheat fields.

raw: [name="Federico"]The crackdown on the manufacturing of firearms and explosives. The firearms workshops being shut down.
speaker: Federico
content: The crackdown on the manufacturing of firearms and explosives. The firearms workshops being shut down.

raw: [name="Arturia"]The sudden change in Landen Monastery's role.
speaker: Arturia
content: The sudden change in Landen Monastery's role.

raw: [name="Federico"]The abrupt changes in the administration of the Curia. The colleagues who suddenly appeared to interfere with my investigation.
speaker: Federico
content: The abrupt changes in the administration of the Curia. The colleagues who suddenly appeared to interfere with my investigation.

raw: [name="Federico"]It was the appearance of Richele and his men, despite the fact that he should not have known my movements, that confirmed my suspicions. Otherwise, I would have continued my efforts to apprehend you.
speaker: Federico
content: It was the appearance of Richele and his men, despite the fact that he should not have known my movements, that confirmed my suspicions. Otherwise, I would have continued my efforts to apprehend you.

raw: [name="Arturia"]All of these anomalies converge at this Shrine of Nurtury, which seems to have appeared out of nowhere, and the Nativity that so many have fixed their eyes on.
speaker: Arturia
content: All of these anomalies converge at this Shrine of Nurtury, which seems to have appeared out of nowhere, and the Nativity that so many have fixed their eyes on.

raw: [name="Federico"]The missing mother you were investigating from the nomadic abbey was the pregnant arborbeast?
speaker: Federico
content: The missing mother you were investigating from the nomadic abbey was the pregnant arborbeast?

speaker: Arturia
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Arturia"]By chance, my music crossed paths with the voice of her heart. I followed the trail here.
speaker: Arturia
content: By chance, my music crossed paths with the voice of her heart. I followed the trail here.

raw: [name="Federico"]The singular item that brought me to my conclusion, of greater weight than any of the above, is how the Lateran people are seemingly oblivious to all of this.
speaker: Federico
content: The singular item that brought me to my conclusion, of greater weight than any of the above, is how the Lateran people are seemingly oblivious to all of this.

raw: [name="Federico"]Everything in life has been turned upside-down, but in this country, this city, life goes on, orderly as ever, as though things have always been so.
speaker: Federico
content: Everything in life has been turned upside-down, but in this country, this city, life goes on, orderly as ever, as though things have always been so.

raw: [name="Arturia"]When six million Laterans continue to live as they always have, it's hard for us to convince ourselves that we're the only sane ones.
speaker: Arturia
content: When six million Laterans continue to live as they always have, it's hard for us to convince ourselves that we're the only sane ones.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Self-doubt is an invaluable experience for a hardhead like you, isn't it?
speaker: Arturia
content: Self-doubt is an invaluable experience for a hardhead like you, isn't it?

speaker: Arturia
content: Are you certain now?

speaker: Federico
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Federico"]Mathematics, physics, geography, archaeology, astronomy... no theory or knowledge in science, theology, or philosophy can explain this.
speaker: Federico
content: Mathematics, physics, geography, archaeology, astronomy... no theory or knowledge in science, theology, or philosophy can explain this.

raw: [name="Federico"]A city with a population of six million, sharing the same hallucination.
speaker: Federico
content: A city with a population of six million, sharing the same hallucination.

raw: [name="Federico"]But the present circumstances clearly run contrary to the order of Laterano and the foundation of the Law.
speaker: Federico
content: But the present circumstances clearly run contrary to the order of Laterano and the foundation of the Law.

speaker: Federico
content: I have no doubt.

speaker: Arturia
content: What a coincidence. Neither do I—
